title: Void Tear
description: A ragged tear in reality hangs in the air like a wound that refuses to close, leaking dark energy that distorts the ground beneath it. The edges pulse with a sickening un-light, and the faint sound of something vast breathing echoes from within. Fragments of shattered matter orbit the tear slowly, drawn toward oblivion.

choices.label: Reach into the void
choices.description: Plunge your hand past the boundary of reality to seize a crystallized shard of nothingness.

choices.label: Collect the leaking residue
choices.description: Scrape the condensed entropy dripping from the tear's edges into a container.

choices.label: Search the distorted ground
choices.description: Sift through the warped debris scattered beneath the tear for anything of value.

choices.label: Leave it alone
choices.description: Some wounds in reality are best left undisturbed.
